identity.title: [v0.91.8][runtime-v3][observatory] Repair overnight readiness probes and weather freshness truth

values.task_boundary: Fix only the observed overnight monitoring ambiguity for Runtime v3 and the HTML Observatory.
deliverables: Canonical readiness/probe route behavior or explicit docs truth
Weather freshness surfaced as an unambiguous readiness/degradation signal
Focused Runtime v3 tests proving route and stale-weather behavior
acceptance_criteria: AC-1 Docs name the correct versioned Runtime v3 probe endpoints and do not direct users to unversioned /health or /ready paths
AC-2 Either /v1/ready exists as a bounded readiness endpoint, or docs explicitly state readiness is derived from /v1/health plus /v1/observatory fields
AC-3 Stale weather is unambiguous in live checks: refreshed under normal live operation or surfaced as explicit degraded readiness with tests and docs
AC-4 Watcher recipe uses canonical endpoints and reports changed blockers only
AC-5 Focused Runtime v3 route tests and docs/diff validation pass
dependencies: Runtime v3 ControlService and Axum router
Existing HTML Observatory README run instructions
